text: This is a minimal grounded knowledge node. It is bound to the `ex:Introduction` concept via the `concepts` frontmatter field, and is parseable with standard JSON + Markdown tooling only — no JSON-LD or ontology processing is required at Level 1 (see core §3).
A harness ingesting this package can ground a conversation in this content purely from the frontmatter and Markdown body, without resolving `ex:` to any external ontology.
